title: Returned Payment Fee Lines for Option Deposits on Design Studio Selections Files
content:
Every option deposit payment returned unpaid on a Design Studio Selections file is charged one returned payment fee line, dated on the date Calloway was notified of the return and carrying the receipt number of the returned payment. The fee line sits on the selection sheet with its own printed line number and adds its fee to the file's option total, the amount added to what the buyer owes at closing.

## Ledger tool: `book_returned_payment_fee_69a7241d`

**Capability.** One call adds one `returned_payment_fee` line to the file's selection sheet, dated on the date Calloway was notified of that return, carrying the receipt number of the returned payment and a new printed line number, and adds the fee to the file's option total. The buyer sees the fee line, its line number and its price on the selection sheet and on the design ledger.

**Invocation.** It is an agent-side tool: the representative unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `selection_id` | The reference number of the Design Studio Selections file the returned payment was made on, as returned by the design file lookup | Id |
| `source_payment_ref` | The Calloway receipt number of the option deposit payment that was returned, exactly as printed on the returned-payment entry of the design ledger | Verbatim, copied character for character |
| `fee_amount` | The returned payment fee charged | USD, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent |

**Return.** A receipt with `design_event_id` (the reference number of the fee line entry), `option_line_ref` (the line number printed for the new fee line, OPT-DSR- followed by five digits), `source_payment_ref` (as passed), `event_date` (YYYY-MM-DD, the date the fee line carries), `fee_amount` (the fee booked, USD with 2 decimals), `option_total` (the file's option total in USD including this fee) and `status`, which reads "booked" when the fee line was written.
